title: MT41039: Computational Transport Phenomena
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite - MT21010 Mathematical model formulation with governing equations,
boundary conditions; case studies of some important metallurgical system:
packed and fluidized bed, moving boundary problems with melting,
solidifications and reactions, interaction of gas bubbles and jets with liquid,
gas stirred ladle, filling ladle, fusion welding, cored wire injection, soaking
pits, continuous casting, leaching reactors etc.. Numerical methods for solving
partial differential equations: Control Volume Technique, Finite Element Method
etc.
Numerical solutions of some cases mentioned above. Text Books:1.S.V.
Patankar: Numerical Heat Transfer and Fluid Flow, Hemisphere Publishing
Corporation, USA, 1980.2.R.I.L Guthrie: Engineering in Process Metallurgy,
Oxford Science Publications, 1989.
